steps.name: mdns-deep-check
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
adb start-server >/dev/null
echo '--- adb mdns services ---'
adb mdns services || true
browse() {
  SERVICE="$1"
  echo "--- dns-sd browse $SERVICE ---"
  OUT="/tmp/mdns-$RANDOM.txt"
  dns-sd -B "$SERVICE" local. >"$OUT" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  sleep 8
  kill -INT "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  cat "$OUT"
  rm -f "$OUT"
}
browse _adb-tls-connect._tcp
browse _adb-tls-pairing._tcp
echo '--- dns-sd service types ---'
OUT="/tmp/mdns-services-$RANDOM.txt"
dns-sd -B _services._dns-sd._udp local. >"$OUT" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 8
kill -INT "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
cat "$OUT" | grep -Ei 'adb|googlecast|airplay|raop|companion-link|device-info|workstation|ssh|sftp|http|https' || cat "$OUT"
rm -f "$OUT"
echo '--- arp target ---'
arp -an | grep '192\.168\.0\.100' || true
